name: apexx-vscode-extension
description: Language support shell for ApexX .clsx files.

apexx.compileOnSave.description: Generate the corresponding Salesforce Apex .cls files whenever a .clsx file is saved.

apexx.outputDirectory.description: Output classes directory. Leave empty to use the Salesforce DX default package directory, or generated/force-app/main/default/classes outside a Salesforce DX project.

apexx.apiVersion.description: Apex metadata API version for generated .cls-meta.xml files. Leave empty to use sfdx-project.json sourceApiVersion, then ApexX's fallback.

apexx.javaHome.description: JDK directory used to run the Salesforce Apex language server for symbol resolution. Leave empty to reuse salesforcedx-vscode-apex.java.home, then JAVA_HOME.

apexx.useApexLanguageServer.description: Resolve symbols through the Salesforce Apex language server for overload-aware and org-aware results. Off by default: it would be a second Apex server on this workspace, and two servers share one .sfdx/tools/apex.db index, which corrupts it and breaks the Salesforce Apex extension. ApexX's own symbol model needs no JDK and covers hover, definition, references, rename, outline and completion.

apexx.apexDiagnostics.description: Report Apex semantic errors from the Salesforce Apex language server alongside ApexX compiler errors. Off by default: these catch real mistakes such as calling a method that does not exist, but they also flag code the platform compiles and deploys, so they are advisory rather than authoritative.
